name: Giving Offering
overview: Scripture teaches that giving offerings is an act of honoring God with the firstfruits and tithes of our increase, recognizing that all wealth ultimately belongs to Him. The Lord calls His people to bring their tithes faithfully into His storehouse, promising abundant blessings in return. Giving is to be done with sincerity, not for public recognition, reflecting a heart devoted to God’s holiness and generosity. This stewardship acknowledges God's ownership of silver and gold and encourages believers to scatter liberally rather than withhold, as generosity leads to increase while withholding leads to poverty.
